verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is an in-person payments SDK, API and reader-hardware product, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence of Stripe's own official MCP server (stripe-terminal-docs-35, stripe-terminal-probe-4) concerns the server role and does not show Terminal itself plugging in MCP servers.
